title: Phase 1 Point Cloud (LAZ)
description:
Phase1 (2010 - 2017) Statewide LiDAR Point Cloud - LAZ Compressed.



This dataset provides access to a LiDAR Point Cloud files (LAZ) for the entire Commonwealth of Kentucky. LiDAR was collected at Quality Level 3 or better from 2010 – 2017 for KYAPED project areas while no snow was on the ground and rivers were at or below normal levels.
